The values are a range "1000 kg up to and including 5000 kg". This is a single certified type covering capacities from 1000 to 5000 kg. Not discrete models. I could represent as type_level with value {min: 1000, max: 5000}, unit kg. The type designation is SS300 — one type. It's a range, not multiple models. The rule says lists of values are model matrices; but ranges like "0-9.999" become {min, max}. Here it's a range of Emax covered by one type. I'll put it in type_level as a range.

- Humidity Class: CH → value "CH", unit null

Note: "The characteristics for nmax and Y can be reduced separately. Z is proportional or equal to nmax." — that's just text; could be description.

Label canonicalization:
- Fraction pLC → apportionment_factor_plc
- Maximum capacity (Emax) → maximum_capacity
- Humidity Class → humidity_class
- Temperature range → temperature_range
- Accuracy Class → accuracy_class
- Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) → max_load_cell_intervals_nlc
- Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval Y = Emax / Vmin → ratio_y_emax_over_vmin
- Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax / (2 * DR) → ratio_z_emax_over_2dr

Since Emax is a range (1000–5000 kg) and n = 3000, Y = 6000, Z = 3000 apply to the whole range — this is a single model/type with varying capacities. Should I create a model_family? The cert covers one type SS300 with Emax range 1000–5000 kg. The schema says model_family only if cert covers >1 model variant. Since Emax is a continuous range, not discrete models, I think no model_family. Keep type_level with range values.

Certificate scheme: R60 under the OIML-CS — scheme A or B? This is an old-style certificate (2012, pre-MAA/CS?). Actually OIML-CS started around 2018; certificates like this are issued under the MAA (Mutual Acceptance Arrangement). The schema says scheme (A|B). This certificate doesn't specify scheme A or B. I'll omit scheme or set null. Actually, recommendation.scheme — the certificate number "R60/2000-NL1-12.44". I'll omit scheme since not stated. Hmm, but many certs are scheme A. Don't fabricate — omit.
